pages.title: Viswabharath Allamsetti — first Telugu to finish UTMB

facts.text: Runner: Viswabharath Allamsetti, born Guntur, lives in France — ⚠ first Telugu runner to complete Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc (UTMB)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Race: 176.5 km loop around Mont Blanc massif, elevation gain over 10,000 m; through France, Italy, Switzerland, ends at Chamonix, France; 2025 edition began 29 August
facts.head: News
